tools.name: measure_card_centering
tools.description: Measure worst-station left/right and top/bottom card centering from one photograph. Ask front or back before calling. Request a whole card, flat on a dark surface, straight from above and out of its sleeve. The photo is processed on the server in memory and discarded, unlike the local-only website.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "measure_card_centering" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Measure worst-station left/right and top/bottom card centering from one photograph. Ask front or back before calling. Request a whole card, flat on a dark surfa…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
